does: コマンドから使う場面の関数へつなぐ
entries.code:
match cmd {
    Create { .. }    => declaration::declare::create(&p, …) / instance::write::create(&p, …),
    Patch { .. }     => declaration::declare::change(&p, …) / instance::write::change(&p, …),
    Validate { all } => if all { validation::verify::verify_all(&p) } else { validation::check::check(&p, …) },
    Record { .. }    => change::record::record(&p, …),
    Judge { .. }     => change::review::approve(&p, …),
    History { .. }   => change::review::history(&p, …),
}
